tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gter gsar tshe ring ma'i gtor ma 'bul ba'i 'dod gsol bzhugs/1$0000300 hrīḥ 'od gsal dbyings las bde chen ye shes mdangs// zhing skyong lha sman rgyal mo mched lnga dang*// rigs kyi tshom bu 'bum sde 'khor bcas kyis// gtor ma gser skyems phud mchod dgyes bzhes la// rgyal ba'i bstan srungs bla ma'i sku tshe srings// 'dus pa'i sde rgyas 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug /rnal 'byor tshe dbang 'byor pa snyan grags spel// bde stong ye shes skyed pa'i grogs mdzod cig /gzhi byes nyin dang mtshan mo dus rtag tu// bdag 'khor yon bdag byams pa'i thugs kyis skyongs// 'jigs dang bar chad 'tshe ba kun las skyobs// bkra shis dge legs dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas mdzod// rgyal khams kun tu nad mug mtshon 'khrugs zhi// lo phyugs legs shing dge ba'i chos spyod 'phel// skye dgu'i mos snang dam pa'i chos la sgyur// dag pa mkha' spyod gnas su bsu skyel mdzod// thugs dam ma bsnyel brtse gdung ma chung bar// mdor na 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi// las dang dngos grub ji ltar bsam pa'i don// thogs med myur du 'grub pa'i phrin las mdzod//
ces pa'ang kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bla ma'i bka' bzhin padma gar gyi dbang phyug rtsal gyis bris pa dge legs 'phel/// /
